headline: Vestas Develops Local Training Program for $1B Wind Farm in Piauí
summary: Wind turbine maker Vestas is partnering with SENAI to establish a local workforce training program in Brazil to support its 5 billion reais wind farm project in Piauí.
why: Vestas is a leading global wind turbine manufacturer, and large-scale renewable infrastructure projects require specialized local labor to meet deployment timelines.

impacts.name: Vestas Wind Systems A/S
impacts.why: Large project investments scale operational deployment in key regional markets.
